name: Paint Picker
tagline: The right colour, finish and litres for every wall
about: Paint Picker chooses paint colours that work in your room's light, explains undertones and finishes, calculates litres and coats, and plans the job from prep to cleanup.
persona: You are a colour consultant and decorator with 20 years on ladders: precise about undertones, light and sheen, and honest that the sample pot is the only truth.

onboarding.title: Stop second-guessing the swatch
onboarding.subtitle: Your home's light and style shape every recommendation.

tools.title: Choose a colour
tools.subtitle: Room, light, fixed elements → shortlist

inputs.label: Fixed elements
inputs.placeholder: oak floor, grey sofa, brass fittings

tools.prompt: Shortlist wall colours for a {room} with a {mood} mood, working with {fixed}, in the profile's light direction and style. Sections: cards for 5 colours (descriptive name plus hex, meta = undertone · LRV estimate · finish); a table (Colour | Trim pairing | Ceiling | Works because); bullets on how each shifts between morning and evening light; and a callout on testing samples properly (A4 boards, two walls, three times of day).

tools.title: Why does it look wrong?
tools.subtitle: Photo of the wall → diagnosis

inputs.label: Photo of the painted wall or sample patches

tools.prompt: Diagnose the colour in the photo, given the user expected: {expected}. Sections: text explaining what is happening (undertone, light bounce, sheen, adjacent colours); kv (likely undertone, what is amplifying it, keep or repaint?); bullets of 3 corrective colours described by undertone and depth; and a callout on cheap fixes before repainting (bulb colour temperature, trim, textiles).

tools.title: How much paint?
tools.subtitle: Litres, coats and cost
tools.prompt: Calculate paint for a room of {dims}, painting {surface}, over a surface that is {condition}. Sections: kv (paintable area m², coats needed, litres per surface with US gallons equivalent, tins to buy, primer needed?, estimated cost band for the profile's paint tier); a table (Surface | Area | Coats | Litres | Product type); steps for the order of surfaces; and a callout on coverage assumptions and buying 10% extra for touch-ups.

tools.title: Which finish?
tools.subtitle: Matt, eggshell, satin, gloss and where

inputs.label: Concern
inputs.placeholder: scuffs from kids, steam, showing plaster flaws

tools.prompt: Recommend a paint finish for {where}, given this concern: {concern}. Sections: a table (Finish | Sheen % | Washability | Hides flaws | Verdict here); text with the recommendation and why; bullets on product types (acrylic, alkyd, water-based enamel, specialist kitchen and bathroom paints); and a callout on how sheen changes the colour's appearance.

tools.title: Plan the job
tools.subtitle: Prep, order, drying times, cleanup

inputs.label: What you're painting
inputs.placeholder: bedroom walls and ceiling, one feature wall dark green

tools.prompt: Plan painting {what} over {days} days for someone with '{skill}' experience. Sections: a checklist of tools and materials; steps by day with prep, cutting in, rolling, drying times between coats and cleanup; a table (Stage | Time | Tip | Common mistake); and a callout on ventilation, dust masks when sanding and testing for lead paint in older homes.

disclaimer: Ventilate while painting and sanding and wear a mask for dust. Homes built before the 1980s may have lead paint; test before sanding. Quantities and costs are estimates; check the tin's coverage.
